hook: *15 acres* of planned bus terminal land encroached
hook_b: *15 acres* of planned bus terminal land encroached
tldr: Plans for an international bus terminal at Gajularamaram have put encroachments on government land in Survey No. 307 back in focus.

beats.what: RTC officials have asked District Collector Manu Choudary to protect the land and act against encroachers.
beats.why: The land sat vacant for years, and parts were allegedly carved into plots and sold despite HYDRAA drives.
beats.care: Buyers of such rooms risk losing them; the terminal needs the full plot.

cards.title: 🆕 What's new
cards.body: RTC says steps are being taken with all departments to clear the encroachments.

cards.q: What should happen to encroached terminal land?

qs: How are buyers supposed to check if a plot is government land?
Why did allotted land stay vacant for years?

facts.t: *238 acres* in Survey No. 307 were allotted to APSFC in undivided AP.
*250 acres* in Survey No. 79 went to the Jeedimetla Industrial Estate.

viz.verdict: Public land for a bus terminal is shrinking

watch: Whether the Collector orders action on Survey No. 307.

sources.name: Telangana Today
sources.title: Hyderabad: Gajularamaram bus terminal plan puts government land encroachments in focus

fact: TGSRTC survey finds *15 of 100* acres for Gajularamaram bus terminal encroached.
twist: Encroachers allegedly build rooms *overnight* and sell them, even as police cases are registered, per Telangana Today.
